description:
FILED s419 (Fable) by the flip re-census (docs/drop-census-s419-flip-gate.md
family 5).  8 drops: a call whose CALLEE is itself the result of a call or
subscript, without an arrow between them.

  op/closure.t:722       is $closure_test::s2->()(), '10 cubes', ...;
  op/closure.t:739       ::is $main::113812::s2->()(), 3, ...;   (+ perl-tests/closure.t:742)
  op/current_sub.t:36-38 is $subsubs[0]()(0), 1, ...;
  op/ref.t:668           is ( (sub {"bar"})[0](), "bar", ... );  (+ perl-tests/ref.t:674)

perl's rule: after a complete postfix chain element, `(` continues the chain
as a call (an omitted -> is legal between subscripts/calls).  PCL's term
walker handles `->()...` chains but the paren-call-after-call/subscript
spelling falls through to the $end_pars fallback, which lacks the case.

BLOCKED ON #153 (B3, the _reduce_term collapse) â same standing as #147: do
NOT attempt in place (three s316v attempts in that region failed; task #142).
These 8 rows join B3's acceptance set.  Blocks the announce->DIE flip.


DONE s428 (Fable), B3.1 of docs/b3-operand-collapse-s428.md.  The fix is SMALLER
than the task/design guessed: not a _term_extent change, and no new reduction
logic.  A single normalizing pre-pass Pl::PExpr::_insert_elided_call_arrows (run
beside _retag_* before _fold_terms) makes the elided arrow EXPLICIT
(`$a[0]()` -> `$a[0]->()`), so the ONE existing `-> ( args )` path (walker W2 +
reduction Case 2) handles every shape; a fresh-list build cascades
`$subsubs[0]()(0)` -> `$subsubs[0]->()->(0)`.  Discriminator on the token before
the List: a Subscript, a `->()` call result, or a list-slice Constructor â never
a bare Symbol/Word primary (so $foo(1)/func(1)/$cr->(9) are untouched).

CORRECTION: `f()()` (in the earlier shape list) is a perl SYNTAX ERROR, not a
#411 shape.  The census shapes are $s2->()(), $subsubs[0]()(0), (sub{})[0]();
plus $a[0](), $h{k}(), $r->{m}() work now too.

VERIFIED (tree vs base b70ccaf): guard Pl/t/elided-call-01.t 4/4; reduce-term-01.t
127/127; corpus-diff ONLY closure.t + ref.t differ, each just the previously-
dropped statement now a p-funcall-ref, silent drops 7->5; lib A/B SAME=20/DIFF=0;
gen bumped v2-174 -> v2-175, artifacts regenerated (stamp-only).  perl-tests
closure.t + ref.t leave the drop census; perl's own t/ op/closure.t,
op/current_sub.t (needs #378 for its rows to PASS), op/ref.t un-drop via the
companion.  #411 clears three of the flip's blockers; #259 and #374(b) remain
(B3.2, B3.3).
